chunks: Surely God knows who among you obstruct, and those who say to their brethren: "Come to us," and go to battle but seldom,

key_terms.الْمُعَوِّقِينَ: The obstructers or those who held back

ai.seo_question: Who are the hypocrites described in Surah Al-Ahzab verse 18?
ai.summary: While the verse is often associated with the Battle of Uhud, classical Shia exegetes like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Qummi emphasize its specific revelation during the Battle of the Confederates (Ghadir Khumm context or Ahzab context) regarding the Banu Qurayza siege, highlighting the distinct roles of the 'Mu'wiqin' (those who delayed) and the 'Qa'ilin' (those who called out). This verse underscores the divine scrutiny of both physical absence and rhetorical hypocrisy, serving as a foundational text for understanding the spiritual and military leadership dynamics within the early Muslim community under Imam Ali's guidance.
